label: Gemini 4 Argon
note: Google's flagship reasoning model for software engineering and long multi-step agent work. Reads images, 1M window. 2 USD per million input tokens and 10 USD per million output tokens while the launch discount lasts (list price 4 and 20). Not yet measured in VantheaX: check its work on multi-step or tricky tasks.

label: Gemini 4 Argon Flex
note: Gemini 4 Argon on Google AI Studio's Flex tier: half the price of the standard route (1 USD per million input tokens and 5 USD per million output tokens while the launch discount lasts), slower and may queue under load. Falls back to the standard route when Flex is unavailable. Not yet measured in VantheaX.
